extracted.summary: A partner at Whitlock Solicitors LLP has asked for a call to discuss funding options for an unnamed client, with no details of the matter provided.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for getting in touch with Lodestar Legal Finance, and for thinking of us for your client's matter. So that we can direct your enquiry to the right person, it would help to know the type of matter (for example divorce/financial remedy or probate), the jurisdiction, the amount of funding being considered, and the value of the estate or assets involved. Details of the current stage of proceedings and any upcoming hearing or tax deadline would also be useful. We have noted the contact number provided and a colleague will follow up once we have reviewed the information. Nothing in this email should be taken as an indication of whether funding is available or on what terms.
